input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 9) league-schedule-generator: bowling league schedules with lane pairs rotated evenly

doc_friction.issue: `route` with no --task drew the research track although the scheduled prompt asks for revenue ventures; the session re-routed with --task, as prompt.md says, but a scheduled routine whose stored prompt never changes could pass --track ventures itself.

Playwright lives at /opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright in this container; the browser-click candidate list (/opt/node-tools/...) misses it, so its checks report 'skipped' here. The new eval/browser-bowling.mjs adds that path.

deviations.why: The row's listed next items (47 and 49 teams on 8x9 slots) are hour-long SAT searches with little user value; the session took a user-facing feature in the same flagship instead: a bowling league season with lane-pair rotation, a real, distinct scheduling job the tool did not cover.
deviations.did: Built bowling.mjs + page + eval; added the 6 SAT-feasible misses as the row's first next item. flagship_field.py --make-room parked the 47/49 items to NEXT.md.
deviations.result: Landed: 30 of 36 measured seasons at the bound, the rest within 2, page checked in Chromium.

notes: Verification: node --test bowling.test.mjs 10/10 pass; eval/browser-bowling.mjs 10 checks pass in Chromium at 390 px; eval/bowling-lanes.txt (36 seasons) and eval/bowling-lane-sat.txt (6 SAT runs, all SAT); check_posts ok. Full venture suite and venture-preflight results are in the PR body. Agent doc: the README section doubles as the hand-off (what was tried and dropped, open items).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engine with assignment + local search, SAT check, page, tests, browser check and write-up for a senior engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
